title: aapsclient 3.3.2.1 stops receiving BG value during phone st-by
body:
Good day to all, 

During phone st-by aapsclient stops receiving BG value. Attaching logfiles, and aapsclient build version. 

System config.: aaps 3.3.2.1 on samsung s20, byoda, dexcom g6, nightscout service google cloud, aaps client 3.3.2.1 on samsung zflip 6, android 16, on both phones v3, without websockets, battery and data access for aapsclient adjusted to unrestricted.
